children: Hennessy Capital Investment entered a Forward Purchase Agreement establishing a prepaid share forward with New Circle Capital to support its pending business combination with ONE Nuclear. The seller may purchase up to 5,000,000 Class A shares from third parties and will receive a prepayment equal to shares multiplied by the per-share redemption price at closing (about $10.60 as of Sep 18, 2026). The transaction allows partial terminations after closing, with cash settlements back to New ONE Nuclear at the Initial Price per terminated share, and matures 90 days post-close unless extended. The seller will waive redemption rights on the covered shares during the term.
: Prepaid share forward under a Forward Purchase Agreement
: Matures 90 days after business combination close (extendable)
: Provide liquidity and mitigate redemptions for business combination
